policy.allCitiesRule: 53 cities priced explicitly from 入境游包车报价单_游客版 2026年 报价单 更新版本.xlsx; other 280 cities use same-province reference city pricing (provincial capital preferred; Gansu/Qinghai→xian, Tibet→chengdu)

meta.pinyinNote: py = 中文名全拼（无声调），用于下拉按拼音首字母分组排序

billing.note: Overtime is billed in 30-minute blocks and extra distance in 5 km blocks, following the published quote sheet. Values here are the single source of truth for both front-end and server-side pricing.

allowances.note: Airport and intercity transfers include 35 km and 60 minutes of driving time. Charter packages include the hours and kilometres listed in the tier (e.g. 4H-50KM). The customer enters the total distance/time from Google Maps; we subtract the included allowance automatically.

limits.note: Safety ceiling for customer-entered Google Maps values. A single transfer or a day charter beyond 500 km is not a standard package — such values are treated as a data-entry error: no automatic overage is charged and the quote is sent for manual confirmation instead of producing an absurd price. Intercity transfers are not affected (they run at the published departure-city rate without distance-based surcharges).
